decisions.decision: Each step and supporting note is bite-sized; all authored content appears by default.
Use Round 1 Continuous Outline as the main design. Rounds 2 and 3 are abandoned, with history retained.
Different nesting levels use different branch colors. Notes are readable. Branches and arrows use 1.5px strokes. Bullet dots, note text, and note-rule colors are independently tunable.
Approve revision 92c6464c-bee2-4052-b0b9-190247849e4d, including the user’s final gray dots and note rules and darker note text.
One named parent with action children per completed outline. Independent processes belong in separate blocks. Enforce through lint and repair all 61 affected outlines.
process-outline.single-parent reports errors for multiple roots, empty roots, unnamed roots, note roots, and roots without action children. Drafts remain writable; completion rejects violations.

decisions.scope: Not included in this approved revision
decisions.decision: The earlier top-circle suggestion was never implemented. It is not part of this approval.
